Nestled on a quiet, tree-lined street 1 block to Kits Beach, this rare 2-level, 1,499 sq ft townhome sits in an exclusive 4-unit boutique strata. Bright layout features 2 beds, den w/ soaring vaulted ceilings, 2 full baths & multiple skylights. Main level offers open-concept kitchen/dining & private deck. Upper level features an airy living room, balcony & generous primary bed. Enjoy a SPECTACULAR PRIVATE ROOFTOP DECK with breathtaking views of the ocean, mountains & skyline. Includes 1 covered carport. Steps to Kits Beach, saltwater pool, tennis courts, Vanier Park & vibrant W 4th/Cornwall dining & shops. Easy transit to Downtown & UBC! If viewing on Zillow please text/email the leasing agent.

This home is located at 2535 York Avenue, Vancouver, British Columbia and is situated in the district of Kitsilano in Vancouver. Fairview Vw, Arbutus and Point Grey are nearby neighborhoods. York Avenue has 6 properties presently available, while the neighbourhood of Kitsilano has 217 properties available. That's just 4.59% of the 4,724 total listings on the market in the city of Vancouver. To live in Kitsilano an estimated monthly mortgage of $7,044 is normal.* Properties list for an average of $1,930,130. That is 1.3x the average asking price of $1,487,736 in Vancouver. The average Kitsilano listed home is 1,419 sq ft, has 2 beds, and 2 baths. Apartments make up less than one quarter of active real estate postings in the community around 2535 York Avenue.

* Monthly payments are an estimate based on a mortgage with 20% down @ 2.65% with a 5-yr Variable rate

As well, there are 42 townhouses in Vancouver. The list price of $5,500 is 0.01% lower than the average list price of $1,938,477 for Kitsilano real estate and 99.63% lower than the average list price of $1,487,736 for Vancouver real estate.
